title: Service binary
what: The bmo-discord binary: serve stands the routes up on the loopback with the receiver link, and health asks the running service whether it is ready, for the deployment to wait on.

title: Provider declaration
what: The Discord provider as bmo-chat serves it: key, label, modes on their settings, capabilities, numbering ranges, health, and every room question and send forwarded to the gateway.

title: Discord markdown dialect
what: The discord-markdown dialect: Discord reads the marks itself, so markup and plain text go out as written, a long answer is divided at two thousand characters, and nothing folds or faults.

title: Personal-data check
what: The repository-wide check over every tracked file: no mail address outside the reserved example domains, no home path of a person, no telephone number, token or private network address, as PERSONAL-DATA.md states it. A finding names the file, the line and the kind, never the value.

title: Served routes
what: The service's routes: the chat protocol's provider routes as bmo-chat serves them, and the one hand-over route the gateway calls, which passes what a room said on to the receiving side.
